why_no_secret: TON community TL-B test corpus case OneNatParam, a published test vector encoding uint32 42. It is public test data with no keys, signatures or wallet state.
wire_layer: Minimal single-cell Bag-of-Cells: b5ee9c72 magic, header flags, one cell descriptor and a four-byte body with CRC32. It proves the BoC framing subset, not a signed external message.
